narrative: Iran's weekend closure of the Strait of Hormuz to uncoordinated transit sets up a sharp geopolitical risk premium for the USD at the Tokyo open. The geopolitical escalation, paired with Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole pivot, likely reinforces the dollar's +145bp OIS carry advantage over the EUR; EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1587 and faces immediate downside risk. USD/JPY closed Friday at 160.04 and is likely to extend gains on the USD bid, despite BoJ hike expectations, as retail sentiment remains 91% short AUD/JPY in a crowded yen-short regime. Watch Wednesday's RBNZ decision for further G10 volatility.
